summary: SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: continue Heyasa autonomy dependency semcod/goal:STARTER-029 / issue239. Bounded prerequisite: stop owned POSIX source-hub process groups on timeout and cancellation, preserve real errors/cache/check requirements. Include admitted-checkout fixture isolation discovered by full validation; retain all native gates and classifiers.

delivery.outcome: Source-hub timeouts and interruptions terminate the owned POSIX process group; diagnostics retain output and failures never create success cache. Deliver exact-head source through OneDev and independent Validator. Goal239 full baseline/candidate qualification remains open. Full project-bound validation also isolates missing-config, noncanonical-location and Python bootstrap fixtures from the real checkout.
nonGoals: No NP429 writes, adoption, runtime activation, dependency/version/tag/registry changes
No draft or bypass publication, timeout increase, skipped suite or fake cache/status
No termination of foreign processes or escaped independent sessions

architecture.decision: Use a small POSIX process-group runner for the actual built-in Linux source-hub executor; keep custom runners and existing non-POSIX behavior compatible. Propagate interruption after bounded cleanup, preserve timeout output and canonical gate/cache semantics. Regression tests use actual owned descendants, including a TERM-ignoring child. Seed isolated Git roots in configuration/bootstrap fixtures, and test system-temp classification explicitly instead of assuming pytest TMPDIR is global /tmp.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of exact source change; no operator runtime was changed.
